finite_falsifier.rejection_rule: Any gate exceeding the exact probability, or claiming true-regret gain in equal-risk d=0 without abstention accounting, fails.

limits: Initial ideas were recorded before literature search.
A bounded search cannot establish global novelty.
No benchmark/model training or project test outcomes were read in this round.
PCTMG is a proposed protocol-level composition; no theorem or peer-review claim is made.
The dependent AR(1) check validates only the gate algebra, not a learned ES forecast.
